entries.title: Ezekiel 15:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: 1 By the unfitness of the vine branch for any work, 6 is shewn the rejection of Jerusalem.

entries.title: Ezekiel 15:2
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
What.The vine is only noble and useful while producing fruit: for, when cut down, its wood is fit only for fuel. So Israel, having ceased to be fruitful, they are good for nothing, but, like a withered branch of a vine, to be burnt.

De 32:32,33; Ps 80:8-16; So 2:13,15; 6:11; 7:12; 8:11,12; Isa 5:1-7 Jer 2:21; Ho 10:1; Mt 21:33-41; Mr 12:1-9; Lu 20:9-16; Joh 15:1-6 among. Isa 44:23; Mic 3:12; Zec 11:2

entries.title: Ezekiel 15:4

entries.content: it is cast. Ps 80:16; Isa 27:11; Joh 15:6; Heb 6:8 the fire. Isa 1:31; Am 4:11; Mal 4:1; Mt 3:12; Heb 12:29 Is it meet. Heb. Will it prosper.

entries.title: Ezekiel 15:8
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: I will. 6:14; 14:13-21; 33:29; Isa 6:11; 24:3-12; Jer 25:10,11; Zep 1:18 committed a trespass. Heb. trespassed a trespass. 2Ch 36:14-16
